description: This Java class 'HonoHttpDevice' simulates an HTTP device that sends various types of messages (events and telemetry) to the Hono platform's HTTP adapter. It manages different request types, handles HTTP communication with the adapter, and processes command responses, illustrating a typical device interaction pattern with Hono.

classes.name: HonoHttpDevice
classes.description: Main class simulating an HTTP device for sending messages to Hono platform.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initiates sending data to Hono HTTP adapter.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends an individual message request to the Hono HTTP adapter asynchronously, handling response and command signals.

methods.name: sendCommandResponse
methods.description: Sends a response to a command request received from Hono.

methods.name: sendData
methods.description: Sequentially sends predefined requests to the Hono HTTP adapter.

methods.name: getBasicAuth
methods.description: Creates an HTTP Basic Authentication header value for device credential.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Generates a username string based on device and tenant IDs for authentication.
